facts.fact: 海伦娜坐在黑暗的马车里，穿便于行动的深蓝骑马装。
facts.anchor: Helena shifted in the dark carriage.

facts.fact: 她们把车停在七晷区西街旁的暗巷。
facts.anchor: They were in a shadowed alley just off West Street and well in the heart of Seven Dials.

facts.fact: 距海伦娜上次离开辛西娅已过一周。
facts.anchor: It had been a week since Helena left Cynthia in her sun-filled parlour.

facts.fact: 拉克兰只把辛克莱扣了三小时，律师一到就被迫放人。
facts.anchor: Damien Sinclair was brought to heel by Uncle Lachlan for a grand three hours before his solicitors demanded his release.

facts.fact: 埃莉的预视说辛西娅将被困在红丝绒与黑蕾丝的房间。
facts.anchor: Trapped in a room swathed in crimson velvet and black lace.

facts.fact: 辛西娅穿紫色天鹅绒斗篷，兜帽遮住头发和半张脸。
facts.anchor: She wore a decadent velvet cloak in rich purple with the hood pulled up to cover her hair and half her face.

facts.fact: 门房直接请辛西娅去辛克莱的私人办公室，并允许海伦娜同行。
facts.anchor: ‘Your presence is requested in Mr Sinclair’s private office, Lady Burrows.’

facts.fact: 海伦娜心里冒出一个原始的“我的”念头。
